    • parseSize

      public static long parseSize(String s)
      Parses a human-readable size string and converts it into a size in bytes. The input string can include units such as "B" (bytes), "KB" (kilobytes), "MB" (megabytes), or "GB" (gigabytes). If no unit is provided, the input is interpreted as bytes.
      Parameters:
      s - the size string to parse; must not be null or empty and must follow the format "<number><unit>" where the unit is optional or one of "B", "KB", "MB", "GB". It is case-insensitive.
      Returns:
      the parsed size in bytes as a long value. If the unit is not specified, the value is assumed to be in bytes.
      Throws:
      NumberFormatException - if the numeric part of the size string is invalid.

      Returns:
      true if the class is found on the classpath, false otherwise

    • splitOnDot

      public static String[] splitOnDot(String s)
      Splits the given string into an array of substrings based on the specified delimiter character. If the string is empty, an empty string array is returned.
      Parameters:
      s - the string to be split; must not be null
      Returns:
      an array of substrings obtained by splitting the input string on the specified delimiter
